name: sportlinked
description: SportLinked - professional networking and talent discovery for sport.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
